patches.why: DSH 0.2.x validates request.peer in prepareInvocation and throws gateway/peer-disposed after host reload or session dispose; lazy recreate avoids forcing a client restart.
patches.until: Host typertGateway manages owner peer lifecycle transparently or auto-rebinds disposed peers.

patches.for: DSH typertGateway absent / headless test HTTP fallback (/api/{ns}/{method})
patches.why: Allows unary RPC calls in unit tests or startup windows before typertGateway is active via loopback HTTP POST.
patches.until: typertGateway is guaranteed active in all runtime and test harnesses.

patches.for: DSH 0.2.x schedule/edit vs 0.1.x schedule/update and schedule/delete
patches.why: DSH 0.2.x merged schedule/update and schedule/delete into schedule/edit; fallback on missing-method keeps 0.1.7-alpha.1 hosts working.
patches.until: Minimum supported DSH host version is >= 0.2.0 and 0.1.x fallback is retired.

patches.for: DSH Windows non-ASCII project path encoding (--C-Users-~65E0~754C15X--)
patches.why: Replicates @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format canonical directory key encoding so session logs resolve on Windows paths with non-ASCII characters.
patches.until: Host exposes the resolved session log file path directly via RPC.

patches.for: DSH approval/request omitting tool call arguments
patches.why: Host approval/request hook does not carry command or tool arguments; backfills human-readable detail from matching callId in session.history tool/call.
patches.until: Host approval/request hook payload includes full tool arguments or formatted summary.

patches.why: Host builds vary on accepting provider/model id vs display name or rejecting unsupported reasoningEffort; retries ordered candidate payloads.
patches.until: Host session.selectModel standardizes on one canonical schema and error contract.
